brief.summary: Equity futures were higher, led by tech, but the show's dominant focus was a global bond selloff: long-end yields rose sharply, with 10-year and 30-year at multi-decade highs, and the 2s10s curve steepened. High-yield credit spreads widened sharply over seven sessions while the dollar stayed strong and oil/diesel prices remained elevated. The Fed discussion was hawkish: Kashkari said policy will do what is needed to restore price stability, and markets price more hikes than the dot plot. Earnings and AI news were positive, with Microsoft and Micron beats, but margin, capex and consumer strains tempered the tone. Net, the show was neutral-to-cautious, balancing solid equities and earnings against rate and credit stress.
notable_quotes: We will do what we need to do to get inflation back down to our target.
